tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Develop a retirement income plan for Julian and Elena Mossbutton using Julian's planned work transition (retirement from full-time work at the end of 2027), Elena's expected continued work until 2029, Julian's Social Security estimate of about $3,250 per month at full retirement age, Elena's projected annual pension benefit of about $21,000 from Cloudberry Kite School at age 65, $185,000 in cash reserves at Teacup Comet Bank, household spending of about $13,500 per month before income taxes and charitable gifts, and anticipated portfolio withdrawals. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare a clear recommendation summary for review.
